<｜｜DSML｜｜ parameter name="content" string="true">"""Convert integers to standard Roman numerals."""

_VALUES = [
    (1000, "M"),
    (900, "CM"),
    (500, "D"),
    (400, "CD"),
    (100, "C"),
    (90, "XC"),
    (50, "L"),
    (40, "XL"),
    (10, "X"),
    (9, "IX"),
    (5, "V"),
    (4, "IV"),
    (1, "I"),
]


def to_roman(n):
    """Return the standard Roman numeral for integer n (1 <= n <= 3999)."""
    if not isinstance(n, int) or isinstance(n, bool):
        raise ValueError("n must be an integer between 1 and 3999")
    if n < 1 or n > 3999:
        raise ValueError("n must be between 1 and 3999")

    result = []
    for value, numeral in _VALUES:
        while n >= value:
            result.append(numeral)
            n -= value
    return "".join(result)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    import sys

    for arg in sys.argv[1:]:
        print(to_roman(int(arg)))
